_comment: Tier-2 for febio::linear_elasticity#0. Pins the two reader rejections the pitfall quotes ('tag "material" (line N) : missing attribute "name"' and 'tag "SolidDomain" (line N) : invalid value for attribute "mat"') AND the silent half: mat= on the <Elements> tag is a 3.x leftover that FEBio 4.0 ignores without a word — absent / "1" / "Material1" / "NONSENSE" all run to normal termination and write bit-identical node positions (md5 over the logged x;y;z). The positive control — the same deck with only the one wrong thing put right — is what makes the observed message attributable to the trigger rather than to anything else in the deck. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF). MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 gives the "no name attribute" material its name= back. The generic swap/drop neutralisation is not enough here: the two broken decks are written out as literals, and the swaps in this fixture build the four mat= variants of its third section. Unmutated the fixture still PASSES; mutated it FAILS because the expectation 'material_name_and_domain=reproduced' is no longer printed and the forbidden token 'not_reproduced' appears. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/Schreibtisch/open-fem-agent/.venv/bin/python source.py` (the mutation branch lives in source.py, so the proof is one command and needs no external harness).
